name: caldav-mcp
description: Manage iCloud and CalDAV calendars with native multi-alarm support.
long_description: List calendars and safely create, inspect, update, list, or delete calendar events, including recurring events and multiple VALARM reminders.

tools.name: list_calendars
tools.description: List calendars available to the configured account.

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: List calendar events in a bounded time range.

tools.name: get_event
tools.description: Get one event by its stable resource handle.

tools.name: create_event
tools.description: Create a calendar event with optional recurrence and alarms.

tools.name: update_event
tools.description: Update selected fields of an existing calendar event.

tools.name: delete_event
tools.description: Permanently delete an existing calendar event.

caldav_username.title: iCloud username
caldav_username.description: The Apple Account email address used for CalDAV.

caldav_password.title: App-specific password
caldav_password.description: An Apple app-specific password, not the Apple Account password.
